_help: Keys and books (atlas/CURATION.md "Cards v2"). Per card: keys (who holds the funds or account keys: operator, user_wallet, smart_contract), people (named, with the organization behind it). Fill a value ONLY from a supported claim already on the card: source_url must be that claim's source_url and quote must appear in its quote or statement (check.py and tests/test_cards_v2.py enforce this). keys.basis: operator_says (default; the card shows an attributed claim, "The operator says ...") or onchain_verified (smart_contract only, with contract_url: the explorer page of the contract's address or token on a public block explorer, ladder level 3; a transaction or block page is not accepted). people.names must be exactly one organization name from org_names (a company, team or project; no notes or brackets after it); optional people.role says how it relates to the platform, one of acquired (shown as "acquired it") or announced ("announced it"); the Atlas lists places, never individual people. Open books are never curated here (a `books` field is an error): they come only from the evidence ladder, a supported money-flow claim at ladder level 2 or 3. Every value carries reviewed_on (YYYY-MM-DD, the day a curator recorded it) and needs a "corrected" event for the card on that day in events.jsonl (check.py). Every answer not listed here is shown as "not recorded yet". Idea credit: The Caretaker (The Colony).
